content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: National Institute of Technology Rourkela is an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. The Dipti Ranjan Patnaik Endowed Chair is supported by funds provided by the NIT Rourkela Alumni Group (NITRAG). Only serving Professors of the Institute can apply for it.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice announces 1 vacancy in total, open to Professors of all departments and not tied to a single department. Qualifications, experience and age limit are counted as on or before the closing date of the online application form.

rows.pay_scale: Academic Pay Level 14-A of 7th CPC Pay Matrix

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The experience requirement also includes, as printed, at least three years at the level of Associate Professor with Academic Grade Pay of Rs.9500, or four years at the level of Associate Professor with Academic Grade Pay of Rs.9000, or a combination of Rs.9000 and Rs.9500, or equivalent in NIT Rourkela. Applicants should meet the Institute's approved eligibility criteria for the Chair and demonstrate: Applicants should also show national and international visibility through high-quality research publications and significant contributions to their disciplines. All degrees must be awarded by an Institute or University recognised by the Government. The age limit is up to 62 years. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility rules.

rows.post: Professor (Academic Pay Level 14-A of 7th CPC Pay Matrix)
rows.qualification: Bachelor's, Master's and Ph.D. degrees in Science or Engineering, as applicable, with all degrees obtained in the same discipline or allied disciplines.
rows.experience: Ten years after Ph.D. or thirteen years total working experience, out of which seven years should be after Ph.D. Cumulative essential credit points: 80.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The selected Professor keeps the substantive faculty appointment, existing salary and service benefits. The chair is an additional academic assignment and does not constitute a fresh appointment to a regular faculty post. The honorarium and research support last only for the tenure of the chair appointment. A fresh selection will be conducted at the end of the approved tenure, and the incumbent may apply for fresh appointment. When the chair tenure ends, the incumbent continues in the substantive faculty position without the honorarium and research support.

content_sections.heading: NIT Rourkela Professor Job Description
content_sections.text: The appointee is expected to: Develop interdisciplinary collaborations and pursue external research funding. Mentor students and early-career faculty. Strengthen engagement with alumni, industry and academic institutions. Deliver lectures and submit an annual report on activities, achievements and outcomes.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NIT Rourkela Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, for the Dipti Ranjan Patnaik Endowed Chair Professor position, and it is unreserved (UR).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online application portal closes on 20/12/2026. It opened on 17/11/2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Endowed Chair Professor post?
faq.answer: Bachelor's, Master's and Ph.D. degrees in Science or Engineering, as applicable, all in the same or allied disciplines. The applicant also needs ten years after Ph.D. or thirteen years total working experience, of which seven years should be after Ph.D.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 62 years, counted as on or before the closing date of the online application form.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for the chair?
faq.answer: The Professor keeps the substantive Academic Pay Level 14-A of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix and receives an honorarium of ₹25,000 per month plus discretionary research support of ₹2 lakh per year.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online at https://www.nitrkl.ac.in/Career/Faculty/. Applications by email or letter mail are not accepted, and a signed copy of the online application is submitted at interview if shortlisted.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The Institute screens applications and may call all eligible or only shortlisted candidates for interview. Shortlisting criteria may be higher than the minimum advertised.

faq.question: Q8. Who can apply?
faq.answer: Only serving Professors of NIT Rourkela can apply, and Professors from all departments are eligible.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a new regular faculty post and how long does it last?
faq.answer: No. The chair is an additional academic assignment, not a fresh appointment to a regular faculty post. The initial tenure is three years, which may be extended by a further two years upon satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q10. What happens to the honorarium after the chair tenure ends?
faq.answer: The incumbent continues in the substantive faculty position without the additional honorarium and research support attached to the chair.
